## Send OTP (Employer)

Sends a one-time password (OTP) to an employer user's email address. Use this as the first step in an OTP-based verification/login flow.

### Endpoint

`POST https://jobringer.com/api/user_login_api.php?endpoint=send-otp-employer`

### Required query parameter

| Key | Required | Value |
|---|---:|---|
| `endpoint` | Yes | `send-otp-employer` |

### Request headers

- `Content-Type: application/json`

### Request body (JSON)

**Schema**

```json
{
  "email": "string"
}
```

**Example**

```json
{
  "email": "test_user@jobringer.com"
}
```

**Notes**

- Trim leading/trailing whitespace from `email` before sending (e.g., avoid values like `" test_user@jobringer.com"`).
- `email` should be a valid email format.

### Success response

**200 OK**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "OTP sent successfully to your email"
}
```

### Errors / validation (general)

- If `email` is missing/invalid or the user cannot be processed, the API may return an error response (commonly with `success: false` and a message). Ensure you validate input and handle non-200 responses in your client.

## Purpose

Registers a new **Employer** account and company profile in Jobringer.

## Endpoint

**POST** `https://jobringer.com/api/employer_signup_api.php`

## Content-Type

`multipart/form-data`

## Body (form-data)

Send the following keys as **form-data** fields.

### Required / commonly required fields (visible in this request)

| Field | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `super_user_email` | string (email) | Email address for the employer super user (login). Must be a valid email format and typically must be unique. | `it.job11@jobtechventures.com` |
| `company_name` | string | Company / employer display name. | `test company` |
| `super_user_password` | string | Password for the super user. Must satisfy backend password rules (length/complexity). | `Str0nt!um` |
| `company_url` | string (url) | Company website URL. | `http://www.hindco.com/` |
| `employer_type` | number/string | Employer type identifier (backend enum/id). | `4` |
| `company_description` | string | Short description of the company. | `test desc` |
| `employee_strength` | number/string | Company size identifier (backend enum/id). | `2` |
| `country_id` | number/string | Country identifier. | `101` |
| `state_id` | number/string | State identifier. | `1` |
| `city_id` | number/string | City identifier. | `995` |
| `office_address` | string | Company office address. | `mumbaii` |

### Additional fields

This request tab includes **additional form-data rows not shown here** (11 more rows in the current saved request). The backend may require additional fields depending on the employer type, location, or other validation rules.

## Validation notes

- Use a **unique** `super_user_email` when creating a new employer.
    
- `super_user_password` must meet backend password complexity/length requirements.
    
- IDs like `country_id`, `state_id`, `city_id`, `employer_type`, and `employee_strength` must match valid backend reference values.
    
- If validation fails, expect a non-201 response with `success` indicating failure and a `message` describing the error.
    

## Responses

### Success — 201

Response body is JSON with the following shape:

``` json
{
  "success": "1",
  "message": "Registration successful",
  "data": {
    "employer_id": 54229,
    "company_name": "test company",
    "email": "it.job11@jobtechventures.com",
    "redirect_url": "https://jobringer.com/employer/post-a-jo..."
  }
}

 ```

#### Fields

- `success` (string): Success flag. Observed as `"1"` on success.
    
- `message` (string): Human-readable status message.
    
- `data` (object): Registration result payload.
    
    - `employer_id` (number): Newly created employer identifier.
        
    - `company_name` (string)
        
    - `email` (string)
        
    - `redirect_url` (string): URL to continue onboarding / next step after registration.
        

---

**Request:** [employer signup api](https://request/50256664-946a896d-9648-4bc7-a0b3-bbdb392198db)

Updates the profile information of an existing employer. Send only the fields you want to update along with the required `employer_id`. All other fields are optional — only the provided fields will be modified.

**Method:** POST  
**URL:** `https://jobringer.com/api/employer_update_api.php`  
**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

---

## Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `employer_id` | integer | **Required** | Unique ID of the employer to update |
| `company_name` | string | Optional | Company name |
| `company_url` | string | Optional | Company website URL |
| `employer_type` | integer | Optional | `1` = Direct Employer, `2` = Recruitment Agency/Executive Search Firm, `3` = Independent / Freelance Recruiter, `4` = Individual Professional |
| `company_type` | integer | Optional | `1` = Indian Co., `2` = Indian MNC, `3` = Foreign MNC |
| `company_description` | string | Optional | Brief description of the company |
| `employee_strength` | integer | Optional | `1`\=0-1, `2`\=2-5, `3`\=6-10, `4`\=11-20, `5`\=21-30, `6`\=31-40, `7`\=41-50, `8`\=51-75, `9`\=76-100, `10`\=101-200, `11`\=201-500, `12`\=501-1000, `13`\=1001-5000, `14`\=5001-10000, `15`\=10000+ |
| `country_id` | integer | Optional | Country ID |
| `state_id` | integer | Optional | State ID |
| `city_id` | integer | Optional | City ID |
| `office_address` | string | Optional | Office address |
| `pincode` | string | Optional | Postal/ZIP code |
| `is_gst_registered` | integer | Optional | `0` = false, `1` = true |
| `gst_number` | string | Optional | GST registration number |
| `pan` | string | Optional | PAN number (e.g. `ABCDE1234F`) |
| `msme` | string | Optional | MSME registration number |
| `contact_person_name` | string | Optional | Name of the contact person |
| `contact_person_designation` | string | Optional | Designation of the contact person |
| `contact_person_country_code` | string | Optional | Country code for contact person's mobile (e.g. `91`) |
| `contact_person_mobile` | string | Optional | Contact person's mobile number |
| `contact_person_email1` | string | Optional | Contact person's email address |
| `industry_type[]` | integer | Optional | Industry type ID (array field — send multiple times for multiple industries) |
| `business_house` | string | Optional | Parent company name, if the company is owned by another company |
| `products` | string | Optional | Products offered by the employer/company |
| `brands` | string | Optional | Brands owned by the company |
| `operations` | integer | Optional | `1` = Pan India, `2` = International, `3` = Global |
| `business_turnover` | string | Optional | Annual business turnover |
| `company_registration_type` | integer | Optional | `1`\=Public Ltd. Co., `2`\=Pvt. Ltd. Co., `3`\=Proprietorship, `4`\=Partnership Firm, `5`\=HUF, `6`\=Non Profit Organization, `7`\=LLP, `8`\=OPC |
| `enterprises_categorization` | integer | Optional | `1`\=Micro, `2`\=Small, `3`\=Medium, `4`\=Large, `5`\=Others |
| `office_type` | integer | Optional | `1`\=Head Office, `2`\=Branch Office, `3`\=Other |
| `company_name_as_per_gst_pan` | string | Optional | Company name as it appears on GST/PAN documents |
| `linkedin_link` | string | Optional | LinkedIn profile URL |
| `twitter_link` | string | Optional | Twitter profile URL |
| `facebook_link` | string | Optional | Facebook page URL |
| `instagram_link` | string | Optional | Instagram profile URL |
| `youtube_link` | string | Optional | YouTube channel URL |
| `others_link` | string | Optional | Any other relevant URL |

---

## Notes

- `industry_type[]` is an array field and can be sent multiple times in the same request to associate the employer with multiple industries.
    
- Only `employer_id` is required; all other fields are optional. Only the fields included in the request will be updated — omitted fields remain unchanged.

## Job list (Employer)

Returns a paginated list of jobs for a given employer, optionally filtered by a search term.

**Method:** `POST`  
**URL:** `https://jobringer.com/api/job_list_employer_api.php`

---

## Request body (multipart/form-data)

Send the following fields as **form-data**:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `employer_id` | string/number | Yes | Employer identifier whose jobs should be returned. Example: `84`. |
| `search` | string | No | Free-text filter applied to the job list (commonly matches job title and/or related fields). Example: `sales`. Use an empty value to fetch without filtering. |
| `page` | number | No | Page number (1-based). Default is typically `1` if omitted. Example: `1`, `2`, `3`. |
| `limit` | number | No | Number of records per page. Example: `20`. |

### Pagination behavior

- **`page`** **is 1-based**: `page=1` returns the first set of results.
    
- Use `limit` to control page size.
    
- Increment `page` (`1 → 2 → 3 ...`) to fetch subsequent pages.
    
- When there are no more results, the API commonly returns an empty JSON array (`[]`).
    

---

## Response

### `200 OK`

Returns a **JSON array** of job objects.

Typical job fields include:

- `id`, `permalink`, `title`
    
- status flags: `active`, `featured`, `deleted`, `published`, `drafted`, `expired`
    
- timestamps: `created`, `expiry_date`
    
- employer/job metadata: `posted_by`, `company`, `employer_id`
    
- counts/links: `applied_count`, `view_count`, `candidate_list`
    

> Note: Some fields may be `null` (e.g., `view_count`) depending on the record. 
  

---

## Quick example

### Example request (form-data)

``` text
POST https://jobringer.com/api/job_list_employer_api.php
form-data:
  employer_id: 84
  search: sales
  page: 1
  limit: 20

 ```

## Job Post API — Create a job posting

Creates a new job posting for an employer.

**Method:** `POST`  
**URL:** `https://local.jobringer.com/api/job_post_api.php`

### Request body
Send as **`multipart/form-data`**.

#### Form-data fields
The API accepts a number of form-data fields. Below are the fields currently known from this Postman request.

**Required (typical):**
- `title` *(string)* — Job title.
- `description` *(string)* — Job description.
- `hiring_for` *(string)* — Hiring for (role/position label).
- `job_keywords` *(string)* — Keywords/tags.
- `country_id[]` *(array of int/string)* — One or more country IDs.
- `city_id[]` *(array of int/string)* — One or more city IDs.

**Optional / flags / categorization:**
- `is_featured` *(0/1)* — Mark job as featured.
- `work_mode` *(int/string)* — Work mode identifier (e.g., onsite/remote/hybrid; value depends on your system).
- `employment_major` *(int/string)* — Major employment type identifier.
- `employment_minor` *(int/string)* — Minor employment type identifier.
- `is_hide_salary_details` *(0/1)* — Hide salary details.

> Notes:
> - Fields ending with `[]` are **arrays** in `multipart/form-data`. In Postman, add multiple rows using the same key (e.g., `country_id[]` repeated per value).
> - Types/allowed values for enumerations like `work_mode`, `employment_major`, and `employment_minor` are determined by your backend configuration.

### Example `curl`
```bash
curl --location 'https://local.jobringer.com/api/job_post_api.php' \
  --form 'title="test"' \
  --form 'is_featured="0"' \
  --form 'work_mode="5"' \
  --form 'employment_major="5"' \
  --form 'employment_minor="2"' \
  --form 'description="saeft"' \
  --form 'hiring_for="derr"' \
  --form 'job_keywords="asf"' \
  --form 'country_id[]="101"' \
  --form 'city_id[]="995"' \
  --form 'is_hide_salary_details="0"'
```

### Responses
Response shape is defined by the API implementation. Common patterns:

**Success (typical):**
- HTTP `200`/`201`
- Body includes a success indicator/message and may include the created job ID.

**Error (typical):**
- HTTP `400` for validation errors (missing/invalid fields)
- HTTP `401`/`403` for authentication/authorization issues (if required by your setup)
- HTTP `500` for server errors

If you save example responses for this request, they can be used for documentation and for mocks.

## Purpose

Returns a paginated list of job applications / applicants for a given job.

## Endpoint

`POST local.jobringer.com/api/application_listing_api.php`

## Request body (multipart/form-data)

Required fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jobseeker_id` | number/string | Jobseeker identifier (used for jobseeker-scoped listing). |
| `job_id` | number/string | Job identifier whose applications/applicants should be returned. |
| `employer_id` | number/string | Employer identifier (used for employer-scoped listing). |
| `page` | number | Page number (1-based). |
| `limit` | number | Page size (max items per page). |

### Pagination

- Use `page` and `limit` to paginate results.
    
- Response returns a `jobs` array containing up to `limit` records for the requested `page`.
    

## Example request

``` bash
curl --location 'http://local.jobringer.com/api/application_listing_api.php' \
  --form 'jobseeker_id="257259"' \
  --form 'job_id="52363"' \
  --form 'employer_id="84"' \
  --form 'page="1"' \
  --form 'limit="10"'

}

 ```

## Notes on fields (based on observed 200 response)

- `success` indicates the request was processed successfully.
    
- `jobs` is the list of application/applicant records.
    
- `job_seeker_id` and `job_id` identify the applicant and job.
    
- `resume_file` appears to be a filename stored on the server (may be empty).
    
- Experience fields (`years_exp`, `months_exp`, `internship_years`, `internship_months`) are returned as strings in the current response.
    
- `is_whatsapp` appears to be a string flag (`"0"` observed).
    
- `unique_code` is an application/candidate reference code (e.g., `JR…`).
    
- Some fields may be `null` or boolean-like `false` (e.g., `profile_type`, `current_salary_period`, `notice_period`) depending on profile completeness.
    
- `educational_degree` may be an object (with `id` and `degree`) or `null`.
    
- `applied_at` is a timestamp string for when the application was submitted.

request.description:
Fetches the complete profile and details of a specific employer by their unique ID. Returns a JSON array containing a single employer object with company information, contact details, verification status, and social media links.

---

## Request Body

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `employer_id` | text | Required | The unique numeric ID of the employer whose details are to be fetched. |

---

## Response

**Status:** `200 OK`

Returns a JSON array with a single employer object. The response fields are grouped below:

### Company Info

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Unique employer ID. |
| `company_name` | string | Registered name of the company. |
| `email` | string | Primary email address of the company. |
| `employer_type` | string | Type of employer (e.g., Recruitment Agency, Direct Employer). |
| `company_unique_no` | string | System-generated unique identifier for the company. |
| `company_registration_type` | string | Legal registration type (e.g., Proprietorship, Pvt. Ltd.). |
| `enterprises_categorization` | string | Size category of the enterprise (e.g., Small, Medium, Large). |
| `company_type` | string | Indicates if the company is Indian or foreign. |
| `office_type` | string | Type of office (e.g., Head Office, Branch). |
| `employee_strength` | string | Employee count or office tier description. |
| `operations` | string | Geographic scope of operations (e.g., Pan India). |
| `business_house` | string | Business house or group name, if applicable. |
| `industry` | string | Industry sector the company belongs to. |
| `products` | string | Products or services offered by the company. |
| `brands` | string | Brand names associated with the company. |
| `hq_location` | string | City where the headquarters is located. |
| `business_turnover` | string | Annual business turnover, if provided. |
| `company_accreditations` | string | Any accreditations or certifications held. |
| `company_url` | string | Official website URL of the company. |
| `is_featured` | string | Whether the employer is featured (`"1"`) or not (`"0"`). |
| `lastLogin` | string | Date of the employer's last login (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |

### Location

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `countries` | string | Country where the company is located. |
| `state` | string | State where the company is located. |
| `cities` | string | City where the company is located. |
| `locality` | string | Locality or area within the city. |
| `pincode` | string | Postal/ZIP code of the company address. |

### Contact Info

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `company_country_code` | string|null | Country dialing code for the company phone. |
| `company_contact_number` | string|null | Company's primary contact number. |
| `is_contact_hidden` | string | Whether contact details are hidden from public (`"1"` = hidden). |
| `contact_person_name` | string | Name of the primary contact person. |
| `contact_person_designation` | string | Designation/title of the contact person. |
| `contact_person_country_code` | string | Country dialing code for the contact person's mobile. |
| `contact_person_mobile` | string | Mobile number of the contact person. |
| `contact_person_landline` | string | Landline number of the contact person. |
| `contact_person_email` | string | Primary email of the contact person. |
| `contact_person_email1` | string | Secondary email of the contact person. |
| `contact_person_email2` | string | Tertiary email of the contact person. |

### Verification

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checkVerified` | integer | Overall verification status (`1` = verified). |
| `is_gst_registered` | string | Whether the company is GST registered (`"1"` = yes). |
| `gst_number` | string | GST identification number. |
| `is_gst_verified` | string | Whether the GST number has been verified (`"1"` = yes). |
| `pan_no` | string | PAN (Permanent Account Number) of the company. |
| `is_pan_verified` | string | Whether the PAN has been verified (`"1"` = yes). |
| `msme` | string|null | MSME registration number, if applicable. |
| `company_name_as_per_gst_pan` | string | Company name as it appears on GST/PAN documents. |

### Social Links

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `company_url` | string | Official website URL. |
| `facebook_link` | string | Facebook page URL. |
| `instagram_link` | string | Instagram profile URL. |
| `twitter_link` | string | Twitter/X profile URL. |
| `linkedin_link` | string | LinkedIn company page URL. |
| `youtube_link` | string|null | YouTube channel URL, if available. |
| `others_link` | string|null | Any other social or web link, if available. |
